## Environment

Windows, Python, source revision, export application, SDK and FFmpeg versions.

## Reproduction

Processing options and exact steps. For placement bugs, include timecode, frame rate, track numbering and expected class.

## Expected and actual behavior

Does this affect classification, timing, channel order, effects or readability?

## Evidence

Use a minimal synthetic or authorized sample and relevant log excerpt. Remove personal paths, credentials and private media. State whether the result was checked by listening, DAW import or automated analysis.
